body.name: support-hole minimax handle
body.construction: Construct Le Cam two-point and Assouad families by placing bounded Hölder perturbations of \(g\) inside a shrinking baseline-specific conditional-support hole and pairing them with opposite signed masses in \(\nu_P\), while keeping pairwise Kullback--Leibler divergence bounded; use the induced separation of the two optimized WAOSS endpoints to study minimax excess length across the point-to-set transition.
